verdict.rationale: The Digits Connect API issues OAuth 2.0 access tokens with granular, space-separated scopes such as "source:sync ledger:read documents:write", and write surfaces are gated by scopes like bills:manage. That lets an agent's app request least-privilege access. The official MCP server adds an OAuth-gated, read-only agent path. However, credentials are tied to the OAuth app authorization flow rather than a documented way to mint per-agent scoped keys, and the full scope catalog and lifecycle controls are not evidenced. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance (scoped API keys or tokens minted per agent), a full scope catalog, token expiry/revocation/rotation controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: The Digits MCP server is read-only. It can access and analyze your data, but cannot make any changes to your Digits account.
